mapper.select: SELECT cp.id, cp.crawler_id, cp.title, cp.publish_date, cp.source_url, LEFT(cp.content, 300) AS content_preview, cp.hrefs, m.match_score, m.match_reason FROM crawler_policies cp LEFT JOIN crawler_policy_achievement_match m ON cp.id = m.policy_id AND m.achievement_document_id = #{achievementDocId} AND m.is_active = 1 WHERE cp.del_flag = '0' AND m.id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.match_score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT crawler_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM crawler_policies WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY crawler_id
SELECT id, crawler_id, title, keywords_extracted FROM crawler_policies WHERE del_flag = '0'

#{id}
